mobbin:7db28eda-b3e6-4948-ae78-198c4bc7d.summary: From Home favorites, the user opens Devices, scans room Groups and a device list, and sees health from unresponsive to Online, On or Off.
steps: Home with Activity and Favorites tiles
Devices: Off badges and Echo Online
Devices: On badges and Echo Online
steal: Room Groups such as Bedroom sit above the flat device list (screen 2), so the user jumps by place before scanning endpoints.
A red dot and 'Device is unresponsive' under the device name (screen 2) show the problem without opening the device.
Controllable devices show On/Off badges while always-on devices show Offline/Online text (screens 3-4), matching how each device works.
A map-pin control with 'Set up map view…' (screen 2) offers a floor-plan glance as another overview.
avoid: Dashed 'Shop' and Suggested Favorite cards (screens 1-2) clutter the health overview with commerce placeholders.
mobbin:7db28eda-b3e6-4948-ae78-198c4bc7d.fit: Recording: informs Center Overview and scheduled self-test with a room-grouped device list showing unresponsive versus Online/On/Off.

mobbin:4a2af2e6-86bb-4af2-a8cf-dc106008e.summary: From Communication, the user opens 'Announce', writes text, uses voice, or picks a sound preset, sends, and gets confirmation that the message reached all supported devices.
steal: 'Announce' and 'Drop In' are separate top actions (screen 1), because one-way broadcast and live intercom are different controls.
Keyboard, Sounds and Popular tabs sit under one compose screen (screens 2-3), so the user can type, speak or pick a cue without leaving.
One-tap sound presets and an 'Add Sounds' list with preview play (screens 2-3) give stock cues for common room prompts.
After send, 'Announced to all supported devices' plus 'New Announcement' (screen 5) proves delivery and lets the user repeat.
avoid: The flow broadcasts to 'all supported devices' with no room or device picker (screen 5), but Essentials needs explicit room versus simulator (manikin) targets.
mobbin:4a2af2e6-86bb-4af2-a8cf-dc106008e.fit: Recording: shapes the announcement panel outside the SRV as compose then confirm delivery; Essentials should add room versus simulator targets before send.
